OpsBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected for org zephyrgate — sustained QPS spike (~6x baseline). Auto-throttle engaged; a subset of requests are returning 429. Root hit at 1715309123.
Mia R: Paging on-call SRE @Sam T — seeing 429s for the org's paid tier, p95 latency up slightly. Customer impact: intermittent failures to completion, <1% endpoints affected so far.
Sam T: On it. Any deploys in last 30m? Synthetic traffic?
Jordan L: No deploys. Customer support thread shows sudden surge from embedded widget traffic. Looks legitimate.
Devin K: Proposal: apply emergency per-org QPS override from 100 -> 300 with a 5min ramp and 60m expiry. Also disable non-essential streaming/sync calls for zephyrgate to reduce load. I can push override if we agree.
Elaine P: +1 for override. Support should notify customer about temporary change and ask for cause.
Sam T: I'll take the handoff. Applying override now. Command I'm running:
```
POST /internal/orgs/zephyrgate/overrides
{ "qps": 300, "ramp_seconds": 300, "expires_in_seconds": 3600, "reason": "emergency spike - temporary" }
```
Sam T: Change submitted. Change ID ORGOV-7123.
OpsBot: Action recorded: override ORGOV-7123 applied by Sam T at 1715309348. Telemetry: 429 rate trending down within 90s.
Mia R: Support pinged zephyrgate: "We've applied a temporary throttle increase and are monitoring. Please let us know if this traffic is expected."
Jordan L: Also toggled off featureflag `widget_debug_logging` for zephyrgate -> estimated 10-15% reduction in internal heartbeat traffic.
Devin K: Monitoring metrics: request success rate improving, latency stable. Note token cost increased ~2.5x due to higher throughput; set temporary budget alert if >4x.
Sam T: Handoff note: I'll be on-call for 25 more minutes then pass to @Elaine P. If spike persists beyond +45m, plan is to isolate paid endpoints with stricter RL and enable secondary fallback model for heavy requests.
Elaine P: Acknowledged — I'll monitor. If errors creep back above 1% for paid tier, I'll escalate to runtime eng. Leaving override expiry at 60m for now.
PagerDuty: New incident note added by Sam T: "Applied emergency QPS override ORGOV-7123, monitoring. Support notified."
Mia R: Created post-incident checklist stub in #postmortems for zephyrgate spike — will fill after stabilization.
Sam T: Monitoring continuing, will update if anything changes. react :thumbsup:
Elaine P: Taking watch. If we see anomalous source IPs or bot patterns, we'll apply IP-based shaping and block rules.
Jordan L: Current snapshot: successful requests recovered to 99.6%, 429s <0.2% after override.
Devin K: Leaving an explicit rollback command in runbook: `DELETE /internal/orgs/zephyrgate/overrides/ORGOV-7123` once traffic normalizes.
Sam T: Closing the active chatter; incident remains open in pager with ORGOV-7123. Will escalate to postmortem if root cause not identified.
